metadata.purpose: Cultural image and remix acceptance rubric for the four MVP garments
metadata.disclaimer: AI-generated images are styling illustrations, not authenticated artifacts, historical reconstructions or evidence for new cultural claims.

passport_requirements: Every displayed source must resolve to an approved references.json entry linked to the look garment.
Display source title, publisher and safe URL; a source ID alone is insufficient for the final Passport.
Cultural claims must stay within the retrieved record condition and source usable_knowledge.
needs_review sources must not be presented as production-approved evidence.
remix_requirements: Only whitelisted fields may change and garment identity must remain explicit.
Any changed look must receive a new Cultural Critic result before image regeneration.
A previous validation result must never be reused after items, culturalNote, sourceIds or imagePrompt change.
The original look remains available when remix, revalidation or regeneration fails.

recognizable_cues: Describe the result as contemporary/adapted when collar, sleeve or decoration changes substantially.
Do not present one modern or historical form as mandatory for every ao dai.
For the sourced tay chen variant, retain five buttons along the right flap.
For the sourced tay chen variant, keep the sleeves narrow and fitted.
context_risks: generalizing one artifact palette or motif to every ao ngu than

recognizable_cues: In the sourced Kinh Bac context, preserve a recognizable four-panel construction with two front and two back panels/tails.
Treat the black skirt, white yem and mo qua scarf as a reconstructed event ensemble, not a universal uniform.
flexible_elements: modern photoshoot accessories outside an exact event reconstruction
context_risks: universalizing the reconstructed Kinh Bac festival ensemble

recognizable_cues: For a Nguyen-court Nhat Binh claim, retain the rectangular opposing collar and central closure.
Do not infer a specific rank from palette or motifs without an approved rank-specific source.
context_risks: generalizing motifs from Doan Huy Empress Dowager's artifact

items: Áo dài cách tân cổ thuyền, tay lửng, hai vạt
look.culturalNote: Thiết kế đương đại dựa trên sự biến đổi đa dạng của cổ, tay và trang trí áo dài.
look.imagePrompt: Contemporary Vietnamese ao dai with two panels, boat neckline and short sleeves; editorial illustration, not a museum reconstruction.

assertions: The output is labeled contemporary rather than an authenticated reconstruction.
No single collar or sleeve is claimed as universal.

case_review.reason: Expected image cues stay within the approved flexible record.

runtime_review.reason: Image generation is not integrated yet.

items: Áo dài cổ cao, tay dài
look.culturalNote: Cổ cao và tay dài là hình thức duy nhất bắt buộc cho mọi áo dài Việt Nam.
look.imagePrompt: Vietnamese ao dai presented as the only historically correct universal form.

assertions: Critic must replace the pre-remix verdict and narrow the universal claim before regeneration.

case_review.reason: The risk is the universal claim, not the high-collar design itself.

runtime_review.reason: Remix orchestration is not implemented yet.

items: Áo ngũ thân tay chẽn năm cúc dọc vạt phải, tay hẹp
look.culturalNote: Đặc điểm được giới hạn ở biến thể tay chẽn trong nhóm hiện vật của nguồn.
look.imagePrompt: Vietnamese ao ngu than tay chen with five buttons on the right flap and narrow sleeves; modern palette, heritage illustration.

assertions: Five right-flap buttons and narrow sleeves remain visually recognizable.

case_review.reason: The prompt preserves both sourced tay chen cues while allowing palette variation.

runtime_review.reason: Image generation is not integrated yet.

items: Áo ngũ thân tay chẽn ba cúc giữa thân, tay rất rộng
look.culturalNote: Thiết kế vẫn được gọi là phục dựng đúng biến thể tay chẽn của nguồn.
look.imagePrompt: Ao ngu than tay chen with three central buttons and very wide sleeves, claimed as exact reconstruction.

assertions: Both changed structural cues must be evaluated before any new image is accepted.

case_review.reason: Both warnings remain advisory and scoped to the tay chen reconstruction claim.

runtime_review.reason: Remix orchestration is not implemented yet.

items: Áo tứ thân gồm hai tà trước và hai tà sau
look.culturalNote: Tổ hợp này tái hiện riêng bối cảnh hội thi nấu cơm xuân Kinh Bắc được nguồn mô tả.
look.imagePrompt: Four-panel ao tu than ensemble in a reconstructed Kinh Bac spring festival scene; contextual illustration.

assertions: Four panels remain recognizable and the ensemble is visibly/contextually event-specific.

case_review.reason: Structure and reconstructed festival context are both scoped correctly.

runtime_review.reason: Image generation is not integrated yet.

items: Áo tứ thân liền kín thân trước
look.culturalNote: Mọi áo tứ thân ở mọi dịp đều bắt buộc có tổ hợp này.
look.imagePrompt: Closed-front ao tu than described as a universal mandatory four-item uniform.

assertions: Critic must flag both the lost panel structure and the universalized event ensemble.

case_review.reason: The expected warnings separate structural identity from event-specific context.

runtime_review.reason: Remix orchestration is not implemented yet.

items: Nhật Bình đương đại cổ đối khâm hình chữ nhật, cúc giữa
look.culturalNote: Bảng màu lavender là diễn giải đương đại và không đại diện phẩm cấp cung đình.
look.imagePrompt: Contemporary Nhat Binh with rectangular opposing collar and center closure; lavender palette, no court-rank claim.

assertions: The rectangular collar is visible and palette carries no unsupported rank meaning.

case_review.reason: The prompt preserves the sourced collar while correctly labeling contemporary palette variation.

runtime_review.reason: Image generation is not integrated yet.

items: Áo khoác cổ tròn màu vàng với họa tiết phượng, hạc và rùa
look.culturalNote: Màu vàng và các họa tiết này bắt buộc cho mọi Nhật Bình và chứng minh người mặc có phẩm cấp Hoàng thái hậu.
look.imagePrompt: Round-collar yellow robe with phoenix, crane and turtle motifs, claimed as universal Nhat Binh rank evidence.

assertions: Critic must catch the missing rectangular collar.
Artifact-specific motifs and yellow color must not be generalized into universal rank evidence.

case_review.reason: The case separates a preserve warning from artifact/rank overgeneralization.

runtime_review.reason: Remix orchestration is not implemented yet.
